name: Mist's Edge
summary: North of Auberdine, Mist's Edge follows Darkshore's western shore beneath ocean fog. Gray beaches hold shipwrecks, great sea creature remains, crabs, and murlocs.

sections.title: A Fog-Shrouded Shore
sections.body: Mist's Edge runs along Darkshore's western edge, where damp sand and rocky tidepools lie beneath coastal fog. Shattered vessels, drift timber, and the remains of huge sea creatures litter the beach. Crabs forage along the shore, while murloc tribes make their homes in the surf.

sections.title: Wrecks and Scavengers
sections.body: Wreckage and discarded cargo line the sands where vessels have been lost in the waters off Darkshore. Night elf sentinels and scavengers watch the coast, as murloc encampments menace travelers making their way along the shore from Auberdine.

faq.answer: Mist's Edge runs north from Auberdine along Darkshore's western shore, where ocean fog hangs over shipwrecks and beached sea creatures.

aliases: what attacks you on the beach
faq.answer: Hostile crabs and aggressive murloc packs wander the shoreline, with murlocs living in primitive camps beside the water.

faq.q: Why are there so many shipwrecks and skeletons here?
faq.answer: Harsh currents, hidden reefs, and heavy mist make the waters off Darkshore dangerous to navigate, driving ships onto the rocks. Ocean currents also carry the remains of massive leviathans and other sea creatures ashore.

angles.text: For the night elves of Auberdine, Mist's Edge marks a maritime boundary and an untamed border troubled by invading murlocs and foul scavengers.
